Alex — great to talk. Recap below plus three options you can pick from; will follow with a formal quote once you confirm which path looks best. Attachments: redwood_pricing_grid_v2.xlsx, proposed_blend_summary.pdf

Recap of ask:
- Add ~150M tokens/month starting early July across:
  * Route A: full-generation (chat prompts + long responses) ~100M tokens/mo
  * Route B: lightweight reranking / embedding calls ~50M tokens/mo
- Target blended budget: $0.9k–$1.6k / 1M tokens

High-level constraints:
- Dedicated capacity lead time: typically 2–3 weeks provisioning for reserved GPU pool; can do faster (7–10 days) with burst capacity enabled but at a premium.
- Blended pricing requires a volume commit and 90-day initial term for step-up bands.

Three commercial options (illustrative rates):
1) Conservative step-up (no blended discount):
   - 0–50M: $2,000 / 1M
   - 50–100M: $1,700 / 1M
   - 100–150M: $1,450 / 1M
   Effective blended at 150M: ~$1,600 / 1M

2) Aggressive blended (preferred if you commit to 6-month ramp):
   - Base route (full-generation): $1,250 / 1M
   - Rerank-only route: $650 / 1M
   - Weighted blended (100M gen + 50M rerank) => ~ $1,050 / 1M
   - Requires 6-month roll commitment and a 15% prepay or invoice cadence.

3) Platform-participation (pilot + blended guarantee):
   - 3-month pilot at $1,400 / 1M for first 75M; if you hit 150M by month 3, we refund the delta to hit the target blended $1,000 / 1M (as a credit).
   - Good if you want a lower upfront commercial risk.

Notes on unit economics and routing:
- We can route short-form/rerank traffic to a quantized model variant (lower per-token cost) — that produces the rerank-only route pricing above. This requires model compatibility testing (takes 3–5 days).
- KV/prefix caching expected to reduce long-run token spend for chat-heavy prompts; we include caching suggestions in the attached pricing grid.

Next steps (suggested):
- You confirm which option (1/2/3) you'd like pricing formalized for.
- We run a quick compatibility check for rerank model (2–3 business days).
- I loop in finance to produce a formal PO-ready quote and a HubSpot quote record.

If you want, we can also produce a blended, per-route invoice example so your FP&A can see cashflow.

Thanks — Rafael
